issues.evidence: Customer email (received 2026-10-27): 'A stone thrown up on the A6 motorway on 26 October 2026 cracked my windscreen' — this is glass breakage, not a collision. Contract Article 2 (document 2630#10414, page 1): C2 covers 'Damage to the insured vehicle after a collision'; C3 covers 'Windscreen, side windows'. C3 is listed in the Policy Schedule for VER-1007, so the claim is payable, but under C3, not C2.

issues.field: deductible / payout (derived from the wrong coverage)
issues.should_be: C3 standard deductible is €50 (the €300 deductible belongs to C2), so the deductible/payout computed from the recorded C2 coverage are wrong
issues.evidence: Contract Article 2 coverage table (document 2630#10414, page 1): C2 standard deductible €300, C3 standard deductible €50. Article 5.2 not-at-fault waiver applies only to C2, so it cannot be used here. Amounts themselves are computed by the claims system; only the coverage fact feeding them is wrong.

verdict.summary: The claim is a windscreen glass breakage and should be recorded under coverage C3 (deductible €50), not C2 as recorded; all other facts (dates, €1,180 incl. VAT quote, no fault, no third party, photos + quote provided, reported within 5 days, no exclusion, no assessor needed) match the email, the quote and the contract, so the payment should proceed only after the coverage is corrected.
